description: This file contains the Bootstrap v3.3.7 JavaScript library code, including support for transitions, alerts, buttons, carousels, collapse, dropdowns, and modals, with version-specific and component-specific implementations.

classes.name: Alert
classes.description: Handles alert component behavior including close functionality.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: Manages button states, toggling, and related UI interactions.

classes.name: Carousel
classes.description: Controls carousel/slideshow component including slide transitions and controls.

classes.name: Collapse
classes.description: Enables collapse/expand behavior for elements like accordions.

classes.name: Dropdown
classes.description: Manages dropdown menu toggling and keyboard navigation.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: Handles modal dialog display, hiding, backdrop, and focus management.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: Provides tooltip UI component with positioning, content, and show/hide behavior.

classes.name: Popver
classes.description: Provides popover UI component extending tooltip with additional content and structure.

classes.name: ScrollSpy
classes.description: Tracks scrolling to update active navigation links based on scroll position.

classes.name: Tab
classes.description: Manages tabbed navigation interface, including activation and transition effects.

classes.name: Affix
classes.description: Enables sticky positioning of elements based on scroll position.

classes.name: Affix
classes.description: Handles sticky positioning of elements based on scroll position, including methods for state determination, offset calculation, and event handling.

methods.name: transitionEnd
methods.description: Detects the end event name for CSS transitions.

methods.name: emulateTransitionEnd
methods.description: Simulates transition end event after a specified duration.

methods.name: Alert.prototype.close
methods.description: Closes and removes alert elements.

methods.name: Button.prototype.setState
methods.description: Sets the button's state, such as loading or default.

methods.name: Carousel.prototype.slide
methods.description: Performs slide transition to next or previous item.

methods.name: Collapse.prototype.show
methods.description: Expands the collapse element.

methods.name: Dropdown.prototype.toggle
methods.description: Toggles dropdown menu visibility.

methods.name: Modal.prototype.show
methods.description: Displays the modal dialog.

methods.name: Tooltip.prototype.init
methods.description: Initializes tooltip with options and event triggers.

methods.name: Tooltip.prototype.show
methods.description: Displays the tooltip with positioning and content.

methods.name: Tooltip.prototype.hide
methods.description: Hides the tooltip.

methods.name: Popver.prototype.init
methods.description: Initializes popover component.

methods.name: Popver.prototype.setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the popover.

methods.name: ScrollSpy.prototype.refresh
methods.description: Recalculates scroll target positions.

methods.name: ScrollSpy.prototype.process
methods.description: Processes scroll position to update active target.

methods.name: Tab.prototype.show
methods.description: Activates a tab and manages transition.

methods.name: Affix.prototype.getState
methods.description: Determines the affix state based on scroll position.

methods.name: Affix.prototype.getState
methods.description: Determines the affix state ('top', 'bottom', or false) based on scroll position and offsets.

methods.name: Affix.prototype.getPinnedOffset
methods.description: Calculates and caches the offset for pinned affix elements.

methods.name: Affix.prototype.checkPositionWithEventLoop
methods.description: Schedules position check after a brief delay to handle asynchronous updates.

methods.name: Affix.prototype.checkPosition
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the affix state and position based on current scroll and offsets.
